entity.description: A file the index has read: its hash, so an unchanged file is not read again, and whether its rows are stale because it no longer parses.

field.name: location
field.description: component://name/path when the file is in a component

field.name: fileKind
field.description: entity, service, seca, eeca, rest, screen, screen-extend, data, script

entity.description: One artifact: an entity, field, service, screen, transition, form, anchor, ECA rule, REST resource, extension, script and the rest, with the file and line that define it.

field.name: artifactId
field.description: entity:mantle.order.OrderHeader, service:mantle.order.OrderServices.place#Order, screen:component://..., form:component://...#Name and so on

field.name: searchKey
field.description: The short name's segments, lower case and space separated, for camel case and segment matching

field.name: parentArtifactId
field.description: A field's entity, a transition's or form's screen

field.name: sequenceNum
field.description: Its order in its file

field.name: origin
field.description: Where it comes from when not a file's definition: derived (an entity-auto service and its parameters, from the entity's fields)

entity.description: One reference from an artifact to another: where it is made and how it refers. An extension's target (an extend-entity's entity, a screen-extend's base screen and its named anchors, an ECA rule's service or entity) is a reference too, so an extension whose target is gone is an unresolved reference.

field.name: toArtifactId
field.description: The artifact it resolves to, when it does

field.name: toKind
field.description: What it names: entity, service, field, location, screen, anchor, transition, transition-anchor, parameter, screen-path

field.name: toScope
field.description: What the name is relative to: a field's entity, an anchor's base screen

field.name: refType
field.description: How it refers: entity-find, service-call, relationship, extend, anchor, implements, subscreens-item, link, script and the rest

field.name: operation
field.description: What it does with its target: call, find, create, update, store, delete or read

field.name: origin
field.description: What it was read from: xml, js, groovy, ai, observed, derived

field.name: originHash
field.description: The hash of the file it was read from

entity.description: One value flowing into or out of a call's parameter: a service-call's field-map and the like, where it is written and what gives the value.

field.name: fromArtifactId
field.description: The artifact making the call

field.name: toId
field.description: The parameter: parameter:service:name@in.field

field.name: direction
field.description: in or out

field.name: sourceKind
field.description: literal, parameter, context, expression, unknown, or form-field (a form's field submitted to the transition calling the service)

field.name: sourceId
field.description: The caller's parameter the value comes from, when known

entity.description: Calls observed on the artifact stack of a dev instance: one row per caller and callee, with how often. What static reading cannot see (a name made at run time) and what really runs.

A Moqui project on this machine whose artifact index may be read by its id, on any instance, by a user with the AIDE_READ permission (plans/design-dev-aide.md 7.4). The read services take only the id off a dev instance, so no path of a request is read; a row whose allowed is not Y is refused like one that is not there.

field.name: directory
field.description: The absolute directory of the project: a Java Moqui checkout, an MR Moqui clone or runtime

field.name: projectLayout
field.description: java: read it as a Java Moqui checkout whatever its sources; empty: its layout is found from its marker paths

field.name: allowed
field.description: Y: its index may be read; anything else refuses it
